body: The manual `Clone` implementation for `Engine` (engine.rs:42-51) silently drops the tracer by setting it to `None` in the clone. There is no documentation on this behavior — neither a doc comment on the `Clone` impl, nor a note on `enable_tracing`. Downstream beads that clone engines (e.g., for forking scenarios or speculative rollbacks) will silently lose their tracing configuration. Add a doc comment on the `Clone` impl explaining that tracer is not cloned because `Box<dyn TraceSink>` is not `Clone`, so callers must re-enable tracing on cloned engines.
